properties.title: General Warning
properties.body:
[Gulf of Finland] FINNISH NAV WARN 642/26
211200 UTC OF NOV
FINNISH NAV WARN 642/26
SEA AREA OF LOVIISA APPROACHES IS CLOSED.
AREA IS LIMITED TO TIISKERI LIGHT HOUSE IN NORTH EAST,
FROM TIISKERIN LIGHT HOUSE 7NM TO THE SOUTH,
UTGRUNDET IN SOUTHWEST,
AND FROM UTGRUNDET 12NM NORTH.
FURTHER INFORMATION FROM KOTKA VTS ON VHF CHANNEL 67.
